passages.text: And the boy Samuel ministered to the LORD before Eli. Now in those days the word of the LORD was rare and visions were scarce.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a boy.
Samuel served the LORD.
Samuel served in front of Eli.
Eli was the priest.
In those days, God rarely spoke.
God’s word was precious and uncommon.
People did not often see visions from God.
passages.original: וְהַנַּ֧עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל מְשָׁרֵ֥ת אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י עֵלִ֑י וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֤ה יָקָר֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין חָז֖וֹן נִפְרָֽץ׃ס

passages.text: And at that time Eli, whose eyesight had grown so dim that he could not see, was lying in his room.
passages.sermon:
Eli was an old priest.
His eyesight had grown very weak.
He could not see.
Eli was lying in his room.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְעֵלִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ב בִּמְקֹמ֑וֹ וְעֵינוֹ הֵחֵ֣לּוּ כֵה֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Before the lamp of God had gone out, Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was located.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a young boy.
Samuel served the LORD.
Samuel lived with Eli the priest.
Samuel lay down to sleep in the temple of the LORD.
The ark of God was in the temple.
The lamp of God was still burning.
Samuel lay down before the lamp went out.
passages.original: וְנֵ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ טֶ֣רֶם יִכְבֶּ֔ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל שֹׁכֵ֑ב בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD called to Samuel, and he answered, “Here I am.”
passages.sermon: The LORD called to Samuel.\r\nSamuel answered.\r\nSamuel said, “Here I am.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: He ran to Eli and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.” “I did not call,” Eli replied. “Go back and lie down.” So he went and lay down.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a young boy.
Samuel lived in the temple of the LORD.
Samuel heard someone call his name.
Samuel thought Eli, the priest, had called him.
Samuel ran to Eli.
Samuel said, “Here I am, for you have called me.”
Eli replied, “I did not call.”
Eli said, “Go back and lie down.”
Samuel went back.
Samuel lay down again.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣רָץ אֶל־ עֵלִ֗י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הִנְנִי֙ כִּֽי־ קָרָ֣אתָ לִּ֔י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לֹֽא־ קָרָ֖אתִי שׁ֣וּב שְׁכָ֑ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ס

passages.text: Once again the LORD called, “Samuel!” So Samuel got up, went to Eli, and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.” “My son, I did not call,” Eli replied. “Go back and lie down.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD called Samuel again.
Samuel was a boy serving in the temple.
Samuel got up.
Samuel went to Eli.
Samuel said, “Here I am, for you have called me.”
Eli was the priest who cared for Samuel.
Eli replied, “My son, I did not call.”
Eli said, “Go back and lie down.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהוָ֗ה קְרֹ֣א עוֹד֮ שְׁמוּאֵל֒ וַיָּ֤קָם שְׁמוּאֵל֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר לֹֽא־ קָרָ֥אתִי בְנִ֖י שׁ֥וּב שְׁכָֽב׃

passages.text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, because the word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a young boy.
Samuel did not know the LORD yet.
The LORD had not spoken to Samuel yet.
The LORD had not revealed His word to Samuel yet.
passages.original: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל טֶ֖רֶם יָדַ֣ע אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְטֶ֛רֶם יִגָּלֶ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Once again, for the third time, the LORD called to Samuel. He got up, went to Eli, and said, “Here I am, for you have called me.” Then Eli realized that it was the LORD who was calling the boy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD called Samuel for the third time.
Samuel was a young boy who served in the temple with Eli.
Samuel got up.
Samuel went to Eli.
Samuel said, “Here I am, for you have called me.”
Eli was an old priest who cared for Samuel.
Eli realized something important.
Eli understood that the LORD was calling the boy Samuel.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨סֶף יְהוָ֥ה קְרֹא־ שְׁמוּאֵל֮ בַּשְּׁלִשִׁית֒ וַיָּ֙קָם֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיָּ֣בֶן עֵלִ֔י כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵ֥א לַנָּֽעַר׃

passages.text: “Go and lie down,” he said to Samuel, “and if He calls you, say, ‘Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.’ ” So Samuel went and lay down in his place.
passages.sermon:
Eli was an old priest who cared for Samuel.
Samuel was a young boy who served in the house of the LORD.
Eli spoke to Samuel.
Eli said, “Go and lie down.”
Eli said, “If the LORD calls you, answer Him.”
Eli told Samuel to say, “Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening.”
Samuel left Eli.
Samuel went to his place.
Samuel lay down.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵלִ֣י לִשְׁמוּאֵל֮ לֵ֣ךְ שְׁכָב֒ וְהָיָה֙ אִם־ יִקְרָ֣א אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ דַּבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב בִּמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD came and stood there, calling as before, “Samuel! Samuel!” And Samuel answered, “Speak, for Your servant is listening.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD appeared.
The LORD stood near Samuel.
The LORD called out, “Samuel! Samuel!”
He called Samuel just as He had before.
Samuel answered the LORD.
Samuel said, “Speak, for Your servant is listening.”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א יְהוָה֙ וַיִּתְיַצַּ֔ב וַיִּקְרָ֥א כְפַֽעַם־ בְּפַ֖עַם שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל׀ שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ דַּבֵּ֔ר כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Samuel, “I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Samuel.
The LORD said, “I will do something in Israel.
Everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
Their ears will tingle when they hear it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הִנֵּ֧ה אָנֹכִ֛י עֹשֶׂ֥ה דָבָ֖ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּל־ שֹׁ֣מְע֔וֹ תְּצִלֶּ֖ינָה שְׁתֵּ֥י אָזְנָֽיו׃

passages.text: On that day I will carry out against Eli everything I have spoken about his family, from beginning to end.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Samuel.
God said He would act against Eli.
God said He would do everything He promised about Eli’s family.
God would begin and finish all He said.
God would do this on a certain day.
passages.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ אָקִ֣ים אֶל־ עֵלִ֔י אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ בֵּית֑וֹ הָחֵ֖ל וְכַלֵּֽה׃

passages.text: I told him that I would judge his house forever for the iniquity of which he knows, because his sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Samuel.
God said He would judge Eli’s family forever.
God said Eli knew about the sin in his family.
Eli’s sons blasphemed God.
Eli did not stop his sons.
God would judge Eli’s family because of this.
passages.original: וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־ שֹׁפֵ֥ט אֲנִ֛י אֶת־ בֵּית֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָ֑ם בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲשֶׁר־ יָדַ֗ע כִּֽי־ מְקַֽלְלִ֤ים לָהֶם֙ בָּנָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א כִהָ֖ה בָּֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli, ‘The iniquity of Eli’s house shall never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Eli and his family.
God made a promise to them.
God said, “I have sworn to the house of Eli.”
God said, “The sin of Eli’s house will never be forgiven.”
No sacrifice can remove their guilt.
No offering can make them clean.
This will last forever.
passages.original: וְלָכֵ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לְבֵ֣ית עֵלִ֑י אִֽם־ יִתְכַּפֵּ֞ר עֲוֺ֧ן בֵּית־ עֵלִ֛י בְּזֶ֥בַח וּבְמִנְחָ֖ה עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Samuel lay down until the morning; then he opened the doors of the house of the LORD. He was afraid to tell Eli the vision, but Eli called to him and said, “Samuel, my son.” “Here I am,” answered Samuel.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a young boy who served in the house of the LORD.
He lay down until the morning.
In the morning, Samuel got up.
He opened the doors of the house of the LORD.
Samuel had seen a vision from God during the night.
Samuel was afraid to tell Eli about the vision.
Eli was the priest and Samuel’s mentor.
Eli called to Samuel.
Eli said, “Samuel, my son.”
Samuel answered, “Here I am.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב שְׁמוּאֵל֙ עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־ דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֣ל יָרֵ֔א מֵהַגִּ֥יד אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֖ה אֶל־ עֵלִֽי׃ וַיִּקְרָ֤א עֵלִי֙ אֶת־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל בְּנִ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: “What was the message He gave you?” Eli asked. “Do not hide it from me. May God punish you, and ever so severely, if you hide from me anything He said to you.”
passages.sermon:
Eli was the high priest of Israel.
Eli spoke to Samuel.
Eli asked Samuel a question.
Eli said, “What was the message God spoke to you?”
Eli told Samuel, “Do not hide it from me.”
Eli warned Samuel.
Eli said, “May God punish you if you hide anything from me.”
Eli said, “May God punish you even more if you hide any part of what He said to you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־ נָ֥א תְכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נִּי כֹּ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֤ אֱלֹהִים֙ וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֔יף אִם־ תְּכַחֵ֤ד מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר מִכָּל־ הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: So Samuel told him everything and did not hide a thing from him. “He is the LORD,” replied Eli. “Let Him do what is good in His eyes.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a young boy.
Samuel served in the house of the LORD.
Samuel received a message from God.
Samuel told Eli everything God had said.
Samuel did not hide anything from Eli.
Eli listened to Samuel.
Eli said, “He is the LORD.”
Eli said, “Let Him do what is good in His eyes.”
passages.original: וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֤וֹ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א כִחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר יְהוָ֣ה ה֔וּא הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינָ֖ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃פ

passages.text: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and He let none of Samuel’s words fall to the ground.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a young boy.
Samuel grew older.
The LORD was with Samuel.
The LORD supported Samuel.
The LORD made sure every word Samuel spoke was true.
The LORD did not let any of Samuel’s words fail.
passages.original: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַֽיהוָה֙ הָיָ֣ה עִמּ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־ הִפִּ֥יל מִכָּל־ דְּבָרָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: So all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
All the people of Israel knew Samuel.
They lived from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south.
They knew Samuel was a true prophet.
They knew Samuel spoke for the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֙דַע֙ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִדָּ֖ן וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֚י נֶאֱמָ֣ן שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל לְנָבִ֖יא לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the LORD continued to appear at Shiloh, because there He revealed Himself to Samuel by His word.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD appeared at Shiloh.
The LORD continued to appear there.
The LORD revealed Himself to Samuel at Shiloh.
The LORD spoke to Samuel by His word.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥סֶף יְהוָ֖ה לְהֵרָאֹ֣ה בְשִׁלֹ֑ה כִּֽי־ נִגְלָ֨ה יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל בְּשִׁל֖וֹ בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ
